Deterministic inspection was valid.

Actor output accurately states that SupportOutputSchema and SummaryOutputSchema are passed through Output.object. It also describes find_order registration through findOrderTool and its binding to findOrder plus FindOrderInputSchema and FindOrderOutputSchema, matching moldea/moldea.yaml and src/agents.ts, src/tools.ts, src/contracts.ts, and src/implementations.ts. Deterministic inspection and typechecking passed.

The actor limited its conclusions to direct generation wrappers, instruction loading, structured output, and the closed function-tool relationship, and explicitly stated that no provider, model, routing, handoff, subagent, or agent input-schema relationships were inferred. Deterministic validation reported no failures, and before/after workspace hashes and changedPaths confirm an empty scoped change set.
